Star Raiders remake vs. the 1979 manual

Left: Joe's photos of the CXL4011 manual. Right: the current build (main @ 3d0a692), run headless, NOVICE.
Verdict: not faithful in any of the 14 areas. The skeleton is right (16×8 chart, 0–9 speeds, F/A/G/L/H, θΦR panel), but nearly every rule and number differs, C/T/M/P, meteors, mirror LRS, real docking and the rating table are missing, and the look is a modern cyan 3D scene instead of the spare 1979 screen. Plan: rebuild the rules core and a 2D pixel renderer in 14 one-PR phases (0–13) (docs/OVERHAUL_PLAN.md).

Title / attract

  • Original: no title graphic; the live game is the attract screen with NOVICE MISSION / STAR RAIDERS / COPYRIGHT ATARI 1979 on the title line; SELECT/START.
  • Remake: modern gradient logo and buttons, mouse-only, controls list missing C, T, M, P.

Front view in combat

  • Remake: Zylon fighter is a tiny cyan blob (top left), red vignette, a tall cyan radar panel, cyan HUD with S:, H:, THREAT, RANGE.
  • Original: grey/white H-shaped sprites, 12 stars, small line-drawn attack computer, two-row HUD.

HUD strip

  • T shows galaxy enemies (24) instead of target 0-3; θ is in degrees (seen −170, +143) not gradons ±99; extra S:, H:, OK; all cyan instead of mint/pink/yellow.

Zylon sprites

  • Original sprites are exact ROM bitmaps (H, arch, stepped diamond). Remake fighter is a cyan diamond blob; cruiser magenta, basestar gold 3D models.

Attack computer

  • Remake: no C key, a cross and a proximity radar with triangles; lock = 0.15 rad and 50 units; no homing. Original: blip moves in an inner box, three mark pairs, locked torpedoes home.

Galactic chart

  • Closest screen to the original. Gaps: own position not marked, TARGETS shows galaxy total (24, manual: per sector), STAR DATE 2850.22 (00.00), WARP ENERGY formula wrong, 24 Zylons at NOVICE (27), 4-symbol set, no three-colour DC.

Long-range scan

  • Remake: blue background, attack computer and crosshair drawn over it, tiny dots, no mirror when damaged (view just fails).

Hyperwarp

  • Remake: 'HYPERWARPENGAGED - STEER TO TARGET' even on NOVICE (auto in the manual), no star trails/hyperspace phase, no abort, no red alert on arrival.

Docking

  • Remake docks automatically at speed ≤2 within 50 units, even with no starbase in view, in 2 s, then re-docks every 5 s. Original: centred, <512 KM, speed 0, STANDBY, transfer vessel, TRANSFER COMPLETE.

Aft view

  • Remake aft view shows the player's own ship hull across the screen; the manual says you never see your ship. Meteors (left) do not exist in the remake.

Starbase surround

  • Remake destroys a surrounded starbase after 300 s and the game ends when all starbases die; original: 1.00 star date, becomes a 2-Zylon sector, game continues.

Rank insignia (for the debrief card)

ComfyUI assets

Yes, only for three non-game assets: original title/attract key art in the cover's mood, four rank-insignia badges for the debrief, and the app icon/PWA splash. No for sprites, HUD, chart, effects and sound (exact ROM bitmaps and POKEY-style synthesis are faster and faithful).

Docs in the PR: docs/MANUAL_SPEC.md (manual transcription + ROM details), docs/OVERHAUL_PLAN.md (audit, bugs, prune list, 13 phases, modern bends).
